priorFindingDisposition: No blocker or SHOULD-FIX was outstanding against v2 (Claude ACCEPT 0/0; Codex not reviewed). v3 is a remeasurement plus the D-167 phrasing repair; no obligation, no flag, and no leftover reason changed.
observationsNotFindings: doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone enumerates only ONE of the two leftoverDesign-true obligations — it names OBL-G10-FX-AUTHORING and omits OBL-SELECTOR-REFRESH. This is the second artifact in this wave with that pattern; I raised the same thing against the DR-124 state-class join, which under-enumerated 2 of 4. Not a finding, on the same grounds: the sentence asserts no closure, and the complete set appears in three other places — authorityClaim names both as not closed, doesNot[5] disclaims closing OBL-SELECTOR-REFRESH by name, and summary.leftoverDesign lists both, with both per-obligation flags true. The field is byte-identical to the ACCEPTed v2 and outside v3's stated remeasurement scope. COORDINATOR NOTE, repeated deliberately: recent COORD entries in this run draw their Decision item 2 remainder sentence from this field. A D-187 entry that quotes it verbatim would report one leftover where two are live. The authoritative set is OBL-G10-FX-AUTHORING and OBL-SELECTOR-REFRESH. The D-183 and D-185 entries both took the flag-derived set rather than this field, so the practice already exists.

PURPOSE CLAUSE WITHOUT AN ANTECEDENT, second occurrence. purpose says 'Replace predecessor self-version closing sentence with the generic form', but v2 contained no 'This vN' sentence — its predecessor.role already used the generic 'Predecessor roles do not claim the successor version number' form. I re-ran the wave-wide tally now that this artifact exists: ten leftover-joins carry the identical clause, eight had a real antecedent, and two did not — anti-lockstep v2 (flagged last cycle) and this one. Both are cases where the predecessor chain was already clean. Not a finding: the clause describes provenance of an edit rather than a measured property, and the substantive property it names holds (zero 'This vN' hits anywhere in the v1/v2/v3 chain). Worth trimming from the template where it does not apply.

'D9/fault joins' appears throughout the artifact and would trip a naive D9-invention check. It is a live corpus class name carried verbatim from the file-08 DR-G10 cell and ided as 'd9-fault-joins' in the catalog, not a minted code. The subject anticipates this and says so explicitly in two places.

The subject discloses 'Codex not reviewed' for G10 v1, the catalog, the input corpus, and joins v1/v2 — every cited review on this row is a Claude verdict, and the artifact never claims a dual acceptance.

decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Nineteen attacks run, nineteen refuted. The subject is a genuine remeasurement of frozen v2 onto live HEAD 4191140 / file 08 f909ddff / required-now 28, with file 08 confirmed moved and the eight-obligation set unchanged. The prompt's explicit token requirement is met exactly: file08StatusToken is 'HARD-BLOCKED pending selector refresh', byte-equal to the live DR-G10 status column and unchanged from v2. The D9 hazard on this row resolves cleanly — zero minted-code hits, with every D9 mention traceable to the corpus class name the file-08 cell itself carries — and the three classes are corroborated across four independent sources including the live register. TWO OBSERVATIONS. First and worth acting on: doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone names only OBL-G10-FX-AUTHORING and omits OBL-SELECTOR-REFRESH, so a D-187 entry that quotes that field verbatim would report one leftover where two are live; the authoritative set is both, and the D-183 and D-185 entries already show the practice of taking the flag-derived set instead. This is the second artifact in the wave with that pattern. Second: the purpose clause 'Replace predecessor self-version closing sentence' again has no antecedent — v2 was already generic. On a wave-wide tally, ten joins carry that clause and two of them had nothing to replace. Both observations are byte-carried from the ACCEPTed v2 and outside this successor's scope.
